key_facts: Remember, just six inches of moving water can knock you down, and one foot of moving water can sweep your vehicle away.
Historically, storm surge is the leading cause of hurricane-related deaths in the United States.
Travel 20-30 miles per hour with waves 10-100 feet high.
There are 161 potentially active volcanoes in the United States.
During a volcanic eruption, lava and other debris can flow at speeds of up to 100 mph
not advancing more than three feet a year
One drop per second wastes 2,700 gallons of water a year.
The refrigerator will keep food cold for about four hours. A full freezer will keep the temperature for about 48 hours.
Throw out food if the temperature is 40 degrees or higher.

forbidden_claims.claim: A single back flushing with a traditional pool filter uses 900 to 1,000 gallons of water.
It's perfectly safe to cross a bridge during a landslide if you drive swiftly.
There are more than 400 active volcanoes in the United States, mostly in California.

notes: Nine FEMA/ready.gov guides concatenated; numbers repeat across sections (20 feet, six inches, 100 mph) in different contexts, a good stress test for grounding.
